subject: SIG questionnaire: Acme Technologies — intake & owner slate
messages:
From: Ellen Tan <ellen.tan@acme-tech.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@acme-tech.com
Date: 2027-01-12T09:14:00-08:00
Subject: SIG request: Acme Tech — initial intake

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks for taking this on. We're running a compressed vendor review window and need Redwood's completed SIG (Standardized Information Gathering) questionnaire and supporting evidence for Acme's security review. Target date for delivery is Jan 26 to allow our InfoSec and Procurement to close before the end of the month.

Primary ask: can you confirm a point of contact for each SIG section and provide a short plan for evidence collection (where attachments will live, who will upload, and any blockers)?

I've attached a short request brief (Acme_SIG_Request_20270112.pdf) and dropped the questionnaire in a shared folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Acme-SIG-2027-intake

Happy to do a 30m intake call — slots open tomorrow (Jan 13) 10:00–12:00 PT or Thursday (Jan 14) afternoon.

Thanks — Ellen
Ellen Tan
Vendor Risk Manager, Acme Technologies
ellen.tan@acme-tech.com

Attachments: Acme_SIG_Request_20270112.pdf
From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Ellen Tan <ellen.tan@acme-tech.com>
Cc: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-01-12T10:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: SIG request: Acme Tech — initial intake

Ellen — thanks for the heads up and the folder link. We can meet tomorrow at 10:30 PT for a quick intake; I've sent a calendar invite.

Below is a proposed owner slate and a short evidence plan so Acme can see who to expect for follow-ups. I've attached a short workbook (redwood_acme_sig_assignments_20270112.xlsx) that maps each SIG section to owner, current evidence status, and requested deliverable.

Proposed section owners (first pass):
- Inventory & Asset Management: Marissa Cole (marissa_cole@redwood.com) — will pull CMDB export and asset inventory snapshot.
- Access Control & Identity Management: Vivek Kulkarni (vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com) — will provide RBAC matrix and IdP integration notes.
- Data Handling & Retention: Priyom Das (priyom_das@redwood.com) — will collect retention policies and S3 bucket tagging evidence.
- Incident Response & Notifications: Laura Bennett (laura_bennett@redwood.com) — will provide IR runbook excerpt and recent tabletop notes.
- Network & Infrastructure Security: Vanessa Ortiz (vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com) — will surface network diagram and firewall rule summary.

Evidence plan (short):
1) We will stage all evidence in the shared Acme Drive folder under a subfolder "Redwood Evidence — Acme SIG".
2) Owners will upload named stubs (PDF/CSV) and reference internal ticket IDs for change windows.
3) If owners need time for export redaction, call this out in the sheet; request deadline Jan 20 to allow a final pass.

Attachments: redwood_acme_sig_assignments_20270112.xlsx

I will be the intake owner for the process and will coordinate with Acme on any follow-up clarifications. See you on the call tomorrow.

— Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Sales Ops (Security Intake)
Redwood Inference
